attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2614/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and cross-refers his teacher to 3 Μαΐου. No year is given, so no `dates` object. Of the ten Hilarion folders the corpus holds, none is of the Caves: `hilarion-of-pokrovskoe` is the Russian ascetic of 28 Μαρτίου, who also appears on this day's listing as «Όσιος Ιλαρίων εκ Ρωσίας» with his Greek row already venerated, and is left untouched. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
